content:
**Gulper Slurry** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

Gulper Innards which have been cooked to make them safer to eat and improve their nutritional value. Still unappetizing but consuming it can make one invisible in the water for a short period.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Gulper Innards (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Gulper Innards | | Gulper Slurry (1) | 

Can be crafted at any Cooking Station with the correct ingredients, after having picked up Gulper Innards for the first time.
